_comment: Chat Cleanup: SkyBlock's own system lines that can be hidden (each category is a switch, all off unless you turn Chat Cleanup on). Other players' messages are never hidden. These lines aren't quoted on the wiki; they follow what other mods match and are on the test list.
blocks_in_way: There are blocks in the way!
no_mana: You do(?:n't| not) have enough mana to do this!?
cooldown: This ability is (?:on cooldown|currently on cooldown) for \d+s?\.?
watchdog: \[WATCHDOG ANNOUNCEMENT\]|Watchdog has banned [\d,]+ players in the last 7 days\.|Staff have banned an additional [\d,]+ in the last 7 days\.|Blacklisted modifications are a bannable offense!
